attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Frost Blast
steps: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

attacks.name: Illusions
steps: |!wild| |!wild| |*Mesmerize|: After this attack is resolved, this character may advance the defender its Speed. After the Advance is resolved, all other characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: I am a GOD!
superPowers.body: Before rolling attack or defense dice you may use this superpower. During this attack, this character adds Blanks in its attack or defense rolls to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Trickster
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, you may use this superpower. This character makes a |!range_small| Advance. If at the end of the Advance this character is outside of the attack's |!range| or the attacker's LOS, the attack ends. If it is the attacker's Activation and the attack did not target multiple characters, the attacker may make another action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: God of Mischief
superPowers.body: While within |!range| 4 of this character, enemy characters must spend 1 |!power| before using an |!active| or |!reactive| superpower.
